publication.edition: First edition, 144 pp. (based on Chaturvedi's selection)

verification.verification_notes: Internet Archive and multiple catalog records verified the Alston translation; the Poetry Foundation and Britannica confirm Mirabai's bhakti convention of addressing Krishna through the analogy of human love. Tier 2: critical edition; translation scoped.

limitations: Braj Bhasa verse into English loses musical refrain structure and idiomatic register; manuscript attribution is itself uncertain because the poems survive orally in multiple recensions.
